def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    advertising = [3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000]
    revenue = [20000, 23000, 25000, 26000, 28000]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    mean_advertising = sum(advertising) / len(advertising)
    mean_revenue = sum(revenue) / len(revenue)
    numerator = sum(
        (x - mean_advertising) * (y - mean_revenue)
        for x, y in zip(advertising, revenue)
    )
    denominator = sum((x - mean_advertising) ** 2 for x in advertising)
    slope = numerator / denominator
    answer = round(slope, 2)

    # Return answer
    return answer
